name: Pentastack

lead: The pentastack is a mixture of Adderall, dextromethorphan, pregabalin, ketamine and BDO that the Australian influencer Androgenic said he used while livestreaming in 2026.
It is not a method for changing appearance. It became known after the streamer Clavicular was hospitalised on 14 April 2026, an account he disputes.

paras: There is no appearance mechanism. Users describe it as a way to feel more at ease in public; the components are a stimulant plus sedating and dissociative drugs.

Reported risks of the components include seizures, vomiting, additive sedation and a potentially fatal BDO withdrawal. Some components are prescription-only or controlled in many places. No studies of the combination exist.

lead: The pentastack is a term for a five-substance drug combination that came to wider attention in 2026 through looksmaxxing influencers. According to Wikipedia, it consists of Adderall (amphetamine salts), dextromethorphan, pregabalin, ketamine and 1,4-butanediol (BDO), and it combines a stimulant with several central nervous system depressants.[1][2]

Unlike most entries in looksmaxxing culture, it is not a method for changing physical appearance. It is documented here because it became a widely reported episode in the community, associated with the Australian influencer Androgenic and the streamer Clavicular, who was taken to hospital after a livestream on 14 April 2026.[1][2]

No clinical studies have examined this specific combination. Its components are individually described in medical literature, and the sources reviewed describe BDO as producing effects similar to its metabolite GHB, with reported risks including seizures, vomiting and a withdrawal syndrome that can potentially be fatal.[1]

paras: The pentastack is described as a mixture of two stimulant-type and three depressant-type or dissociative substances. Adderall is a prescription amphetamine mixture used for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder; dextromethorphan is a cough suppressant that acts as a dissociative at high doses; pregabalin is prescribed for epilepsy and nerve pain and has sedative effects; ketamine is an anaesthetic with dissociative effects; and 1,4-butanediol is an industrial solvent that the body converts to GHB.[1]

Wikipedia notes that Adderall, dextromethorphan and ketamine have legitimate medical uses, and that combining stimulants with strong depressants is a recognised source of danger.[1] This wiki gives no information on amounts or acquisition.
In 2026 the influencer Androgenic said in livestreams and a video that he used the five substances while broadcasting.[1] The reporting reviewed gives no exact date for the first disclosure.

On 14 April 2026, during a Kick livestream with Androgenic, Clavicular (Braden Peters) was reported to have overdosed on a combination of the five substances and the stream ended as he was taken to hospital.[2] Peters later disputed the overdose description, saying he had not eaten that day, had drunk a lot of alcohol and was knocked out for a while, and wrote that using the substances was a way to try to feel neurotypical in public rather than a real solution.[2]

Wikipedia reports that Vanity Fair compared the pentastack to the date-rape drug Rohypnol in an article dated 29 April 2026.[1] Androgenic, in turn, defended the mixture after his video resurfaced, describing it as less harmful than combining alcohol and cocaine and calling it a "high IQ healthy sustainable drug stack."[1]

Wikipedia places the episode within a wider discussion of looksmaxxing's risk-taking practices, which it divides into low-risk habits ("softmaxxing") and riskier ones including unregulated drugs and peptides ("hardmaxxing").[1]

Reported risks of the components include seizures, nausea, vomiting and potentially lethal withdrawal for BDO, and additive sedation when depressants are combined.[1] The sources reviewed contain no clinical assessment of the combination as a whole.

lore.intro: Within the community the pentastack is discussed mainly as a livestreaming-era controversy and as a coping tool rather than as a looks intervention.[1][2]

claims.claim: The pentastack is a 'healthy, sustainable' drug stack.
It helps users feel 'neurotypical' in public.

timeline.event: Androgenic publicly describes the five-substance 'pentastack' he uses while livestreaming.[1]
Clavicular is hospitalised after a livestream in which he used the combination; he later disputes the overdose characterisation.[2]
Vanity Fair publishes a piece comparing the pentastack to Rohypnol.[1]
